events.title: Building a film, one hire at a time
events.summary: You've got a script. You've got a budget. But a film doesn't come from a good idea and money — it comes from people. Before the first take on set, you have to assemble the whole production: the crew, the director, the cinematographer, the locations and the cast. Every one of those choices carries weight, and together they decide what the film even becomes. events.summary: Who you're hiring The market is full of directors, each a real profile — talent, experience, creativity, technical skill, how cooperative they are, how famous they are, plus a feel for different genres (drama, action, humour, darkness and more).
